Interface IModalFormReplier

Namespace
OnixRuntime.Api.Events.Session
Assembly
OnixRuntime.dll

Represents a Replier for modal form events, providing form ID, response JSON, and reply status.

public interface IModalFormReplier

Properties

Form

The parsed form associated with this Replier. Null for raw Repliers.

ModalFormAny? Form { get; }

Property Value

ModalFormAny

FormId

Gets the form ID associated with the modal form.

uint FormId { get; }

Property Value

uint

HasBeenRepliedAlready

Gets whether the form has already been replied to.

bool HasBeenRepliedAlready { get; }

Property Value

bool

ResponseJson

Gets the response JSON for the modal form. Empty string if the Replier has not been used yet.

string ResponseJson { get; }

Property Value

string

Methods

Send()

Sends the pending reply through the response event pipeline. Only valid while the request is canceled and the form has not yet gone to the player. Returns true if the reply was sent, false if the replier is no longer valid, has no pending response set, or the response event canceled it.

bool Send()

bool
